note: Montezuma (the site simulator; technolog-spectrumai/montezuma): it draws each robot from the machine's visual mesh (the CAD design, the root link's visual 'cad') and reads the machine's mass and provenance; its own physics keeps its speeds and turning. A Yax requirements file of tag codes: python tools/export.py <machine> --to out/<machine>.yx2 --consumer tools/consumers/montezuma.json (Montezuma takes them from exports/, published by tools/publish.py: its scripts/update_designs.sh)
